name: Iida Iina
source:
A new member of the student council led by Tomohiro.
She is a shy literary girl, but actually becoming an idol voice actress was her childhood dream. At the time, she made up a play on her name "Iina, ii na! (Iina, likes it)", which she thought cute and became a habit to say. She has been trying to correct it, but it still comes out of her mouth even now, which is a worry for her.

[From the [url=https://madosoft.net/totsu/sub_character]official website[/url]]

She appears on Hiyori's route only
